text:
lee_sales: NovaEdge procurement reached out. They want an assurance pack for a 30-day POC: redacted SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 cert, signed pen-test attestation (they mentioned a "bridge letter" for latest controls change), a short network diagram, and a KMS statement. Need it by next Mon COB. Any hard blockers?

tara_security: We can produce SOC2/ISO PDFs. Bridge letters are doable but legal needs to sign off on any language that references changes in controls. Do they want attestation scoped to POC only or to our hosted service?

lee_sales: They said "POC tenant only" and asked if we can confirm that no high/critical findings affect that scoped tenant in the last 90 days. They explicitly asked if the pen-test attestation can reference the bridge letter to cover recent infra changes.

ben_ps: We usually avoid technical detail in bridge letters. Recommend: (1) standard pen-test attestation with CVSS bucket summary, (2) separate short bridge note explaining scope/timing of infra changes, signed by legal. That should satisfy auditors.

mina_eng: Operationally: if they want external scans against the POC tenant, we require a signed scan scope form and preapproved IP ranges. Also, for tenant isolation we can spin up an ephemeral dedicated slice, but that affects cost and provisioning lead time (~48-72h).

tara_security: Draft pen-test attestation phrasing we use internally:

"Redwood Inference, Inc. attests that third-party penetration testing and internal red-team activities are performed on an annual cadence. Scoped testing of dedicated or staging tenants is available upon request. As of (DATE), there were no outstanding critical vulnerabilities impacting the scoped POC tenant. A redacted summary (counts by CVSS severity) can be provided under NDA."

ben_ps: For the bridge letter we can add:

"Bridge note: On (DATE) Redwood deployed infrastructure changes to improve deployment isolation; these changes do not expand access privileges and are covered by our change management process. Documentation of the change and verification steps are available upon NDA request."

lee_sales: Good. NovaEdge asked if the attestation can be notarized. How long would notarization take?

tara_security: Notarization requires signatory availability and third-party notary - estimate 3 business days. DocuSign e-sign can be same-day. Legal needs to approve final wording prior to signing.

mina_eng: Pricing delta if they want a short-lived dedicated tenant: single A10-equivalent slice for 30 days ~ +$4.2k, one-off engineering setup ~ 6 hours. If they want APAC region residency, that may increase base cost depending on capacity.

ben_ps: I'll draft a short pricing note and attach a sample presigned S3 upload flow for them to drop any required NDA docs or scan outputs. Example: `aws s3 cp scan.zip "<presigned-url>"` - we'll create the bucket path rw-evidence/novaedge.

ops-bot: TASK-4411 created: "novaedge poc assurance pack + bridge letter" assigned to security/solutions/legal/ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/TASK-4411

lee_sales: Action items: Tara - draft attestation + bridge note and loop in legal for notarization option; Ben - provide pricing delta + presigned upload instructions; Mina - confirm provisioning timeline and regional availability; I'll confirm with NovaEdge whether e-sign is acceptable or they insist on notarization. Target: ship draft packet by Fri EOD to allow legal review.

tara_security: Will draft today and ping legal. If procurement asks for raw vuln data we'll require NDA and secure transfer only.

ben_ps: Pricing note in thread in an hour. Also will flag that enabling customer-managed KMS for Private would be a separate engagement.

mina_eng: I'll check APAC capacity and post earliest provisioning windows. If they accept e-signature we can hit the timeline.

lee_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update NovaEdge and see if they accept redacted CVSS buckets instead of raw reports.

ops-bot: Note: evidence bucket path rw-evidence/novaedge will be provisioned after TASK-4411 approval.
